newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan April trade gap drops to $274 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan April trade gap drops to $274 mln.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit dropped to a provisional $274 million in April from $299 million in March, but sharply increased from $153 million in April 1996, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
Exports decreased by 13.1 percent to a provisional $683 million in April from $786 million in March, and 15.8 percent compared to $811 million in April 1996.
Imports too decreased by 11.8 percent to provisional $957 million from $1,085 million in March and by 0.7 percent compared to $964 million in April 1996.
The trade gap for the July-April period of fiscal 1996/97 (July/June) rose to $2.89 billion from $2.82 billion in the year-ago period.
